{{Quote|It appears your path is set, Morgan Elsbeth. I pity you, for I can see what is to come.|Mountain Clan Matron, to Morgan Elsbeth|<ref name="Episode" />}}
"'''The Path of Fear'''" is the first episode of the anthology animated television series ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Empire]]''. The episode was directed by [[Nathaniel Villanueva]], written by [[Amanda Rose Muñoz]], and aired on [[May 4]], [[2024]].

==Official description==
''Young Morgan Elsbeth seeks revenge after losing everything.''

==Plot summary==
===Massacre===
The episode opens with the [[Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir]] retreating in the face of an overwhelming assault by the [[Separatist Droid Army]] during the [[Battle of Dathomir]]. [[Morgan Elsbeth]] takes down several advancing [[B2-series super battle droid]] with her [[bowcaster]]. Her mother [[Selena]] saves her from being killed by a super battle droid. The Nightsisters prepare to make a last stand in a clearing but are ambushed by [[General]] [[Grievous]], who impales a Nightsister from behind with one of his green [[lightsaber]]s.

The Nightsisters aim their bowcasters at the [[cyborg]] but come under fire from several [[BX-series droid commando]]s. Selena tells her daughter to stay back while she fights Grievous with two sickles that have been animated with [[Magick]]. Despite her [[The Force|Force]] powers, Selena is unable to beat Grievous, who gains the upper hand and damages her sickles with his lightsabers. During her last stand, she engages in a blade-lock with Grievous, only to stabbed in the torso by a third blade from Grievous’s left arm. In her final moments, Selena tells Elsbeth to run. A laughing Grievous then cuts down Selena with his three blades. He sees Morgan Elsbeth watching, and bellows at her to run before laughing. He then orders his droid army to wipe out the Nightsisters.

Elsbeth flees into the forest, pursued by three droid commandos. She eludes her pursuers by hiding on top of a tree. One of the droid commandos scans the trees and shoots at Elsbeth, causing her to fall off. She evades the droid's [[blaster]] bolts and kicks the blaster out of its grip. The droid attacks her with its vibrosword, which she dodges. The droid commando grabs her by the neck but Elsbeth retrieves her dagger and stabs the droid through its head, taking it offline. Elsbeth collapses to the ground and falls unconscious, while Grievous' army completes their massacre.

===Rescued===
The following day, an unconscious Elsbeth is rescued by members of the [[Mountain Clan]]. She awakes in their cave dwelling and is greeted by the [[Mountain Clan Matron]] and an adolescent girl named [[Nali]], who tells her she is under the protection of their clan. Elsbeth discovers that her black face paint markings are disappearing due to the waning Magick of the Nightsisters. As the Matron leads her outside the cave where she sees the Mountain Clan members and their cave dwellings.

Gazing at the horizon, Elsbeth sees smoke rising from the burning ruins of the Nightsister village. The Matron says she is welcome to stay for as long as she wants. When the Matron touches her shoulder, Elsbeth brushes it away. Overcome by grief, she drops to her knees and peers over the cliff, with a tear flowing down her left cheek.

===Seeking revenge===
Later, Elsbeth watches a burning log but is haunted by memories of Grievous's massacre. While the other Mountain witches fear that Grievous will attack them as well, the matron tells them not to give into fear. She invites Elsbeth to join a mountain witch named [[Nali]] for their hunt. While navigating over the rocky terrain, they crouch when several Separatist [[HMP droid gunship]]s fly by.

Though Nali believes they are safe in the mountains, Elsbeth is skeptical and says that the Mountain Tribe's way of life will not be enough to protect her people. Elsbeth offers to help. Nali is reluctant but Elsbeth asks if she is prepared to let her mother die while knowing she could have done more to prevent it.

Later that night, Nali speaks with her mother, the matron, about how they would defend themselves against the Separatist droids. The matron dismisses her concerns, saying they must trust their path. After leaving the meeting, Nali finds Elsbeth walking with two other witches. They tell her that Elsbeth has found some weapons and convince her to come along. Elsbeth leads them into a munitions depot where they retrieve several weapons including tomahawks and scimitars, unaware that they are being watched by a [[Ringneck recon droid|probe droid]].

===Morgan's journey===
The matron discovers that Nali and several adolescents are missing. After hearing movement above, Elsbeth and the Mountain witches rush to the surface only to encounter a droid gunship and several [[B1-series battle droid]]s. The gunship deploys several super battle droids. Elsbeth and the younger witches fight back but find themselves outnumbered and outgunned. The Mountain matron arrives and summons a powerful sphere of light energy, which disables the battle droids. The droid gunship loses control, crashes and explodes.

Elsbeth helps the elderly matron to her feet. The matron tells Elsbeth not to assume that not wanting to fight means one is not capable of fighting. The matron attends to her wounded daughter Nali, who apologizes and says that their way is true. The other Mountain witch carries her wounded comrade. The matron says that Elsbeth has chosen her path and pities her for what is to come. They walk away, leaving Elsbeth behind alone.

==Development==
Artist [[Justin Bruce Lee]] did storyboard work on the scene in "The Path of Fear" in which Grievous—who Lee was excited to have the chance to work on—dueled Selena. Lee later shared those storyboard compared to the final animation on social media.<ref name="Bruce Lee Storyboard">{{Twitter|justbleeve|status/1796370555198923204|[[Justin Bruce Lee]]|quote=Can't believe I was able to work on Grievous! Here's part 1 of my storyboards! #talesoftheempire #starwars #starwarstalesoftheempire #generalgrievous #grievous #morganelsbeth #storyboard|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/ZrLxW}}</ref><ref name="Bruce Lee Storyboard 2">{{Twitter|justbleeve|status/1806518899481125030|[[Justin Bruce Lee]]|quote=2nd part of my grievous vs Selena fight storyboards from Tales of the Empire! . . . #starwarstalesoftheempire #talesoftheempire #grievous #generalgrievous #morganelsbeth #nightsister #nightsisters #storyboard  #animatic #storyboardartist  #lucasfilmanimation #selenaelsbeth|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/YF38v}}</ref><ref name="Bruce Lee Storyboard 3">{{Twitter|justbleeve|status/1834426122647601567|[[Justin Bruce Lee]]|quote=Final Part of my Grievious vs Selena storyboards #starwars #starwarstalesoftheempire #talespftheempire #generalgrievious #selenaelsbeth #morganelsbeth #storyboard #notai|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/eLcaT}}</ref> Some of the CGI animation was then done by Senior Animator [[Greg Verreault]], who later thanked Lee for his storyboards and shared reference material he had used in the CGI animating process. Verreault was also very thankful he got to work on Grievous and noted how a great deal of work went into even a brief part of the duel.<ref name="Greg Verreault Tweet">{{Twitter|Greg_Verreault|status/1790122507309080701|[[Greg Verreault]]|quote=I still can't believe I got to animate #GeneralGrievous 😱❤️ Here's two shots I did from #TalesOfTheEmpire along with some reference I used. The 2nd shot is very quick but a lot of work went into it! 😅 Shoutout to @justbleeve for storyboarding this epic sequence! #StarWars|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/nYT0p}}</ref>
